Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Ayaan - 11 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Anjali - 41 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Naira - 9 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
4. Aditi - 9 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ayaan stands in the living room. Anjali and Naira stand near him.]

Ayaan: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Ayaan sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Naira: "That was fun!"

[Ayaan irons his school shirt.]

Ayaan: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Ayaan: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan nods.]

Ayaan: "What next?"

[Ayaan folds his hands and prays.]

Ayaan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
